_why: What a real PMS DOES with a share filter whose conditions are joined by '|' versus '&' — as
opposed to plextv_combined_filters.json, which only proves plex.tv STORES both forms verbatim.
Issue #116. Measured by writing each filterMovies value to one shared account (its own, via
PUT /api/users/{id}), waiting 90s, then reading GET /hubs and GET /library/sections/{id}/all
(X-Plex-Container-Size=1, totalSize) with that account's own server token. The account's
original value was restored afterwards and its Home verified back to baseline.
Observables: 'others_rows_on_home' is how many OTHER people's Shortlist rows the account's Home
shows (the canary's own computation, unhidden_rows_on_home). 'own_movie_row_visible' is whether
the account's OWN movie row shows while its own label is in the exclude. 'movies_visible' is
the library count as that account sees it.
Conclusions the code relies on:
1. '|' is OR and '&' is AND. `contentRating!=X|label!=ours` hides nothing of ours: a collection
has no content rating, so the first half is true for it. It ALSO voids the owner's own rating
exclude (9988 movies, not 9970) — Shortlist's merge was switching off parental restrictions.
2. Order does not rescue '|': `label!=ours|contentRating!=X` is ignored the same way.
3. '&' does NOT bind tighter than '|': `A|B&label!=ours` hid our row. So a trailing '&' clause
is ANDed with the whole filter before it.
4. An allow list survives '&' (401 movies) and is voided by '|' (9988) — issue #115.
5. PMS applied every change within ~25s; there is no long cache between plex.tv and PMS here.
6. A LITERAL '&' inside a label breaks the filter in Plex itself: GET /hubs as that account
answers HTTP 500 ('label!=ZZ&Probe,OURS+OWN' and 'label!=ZZ & Probe,OURS+OWN'). A plain space
is fine, and '%26' is fine with our exclude enforced. So such a filter is already broken for
that person, and no merge into it can be verified.

legend.OURS: label!=<every other person's shortlist_ label> (47 values)
legend.OURS+OWN: label!=<the same 47> plus the account's own shortlist_ label
legend.PROBE: a content rating no item carries (ZZShortlistProbe)

cases.verdict: our excludes ignored AND the owner's NC-17 exclude voided
grouped as (A|B)&C — '&' does not bind tighter
